description: This is a comprehensive unit test class for the Shutdown class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests initialization, immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, getters, and other behaviors of Shutdown.

classes.name: ShutdownTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Shutdown command, verifying behavior, immutability, JSON serialization, and equality.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static test data before all tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies the immutability of Shutdown class instances.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullReason
methods.description: Tests that creating a Shutdown instance with null reason throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getReasonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getReason returns the correct reason object.

methods.name: getCategoryReturnsModify
methods.description: Verifies that the category of Shutdown is MODIFY.

methods.name: getTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getType returns the expected type string.

methods.name: getDittoHeadersReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getDittoHeaders returns the initialized headers.

methods.name: getIdReturnsDummyId
methods.description: Verifies that getEntityId() returns a dummy ID.

methods.name: getResourceTypeReturnsCommonCommandResourceType
methods.description: Confirms resource type matches expected constant.

methods.name: fromJsonWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON produces the correct Shutdown instance.

methods.name: fromJsonWithoutReason
methods.description: Tests deserialization when JSON lacks reason, ensures default is used.

methods.name: toJsonWithoutSchemaVersionAndPredicateReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures toJson produces expected JSON structure.

methods.name: toJsonWithoutReason
methods.description: Checks JSON serialization when reason is omitted.

methods.name: toStringContainsExpected
